title: Exact T1 persistent expert processes with accepted-assignment recovery

training_method.label: Independent frozen-head sparse control steps
training_method.description: Each assignment starts from the same deterministic initialization and produces one isolated coordinator AdamW control step. This is not a sequential training trajectory.

execution_topology.label: Sequential persistent local expert processes
execution_topology.description: One matched full process and four expert-affine processes run one at a time. Stable children retain the frozen head across two assignments while trainable state is refreshed for each assignment.

memory_profiles.label: Per-child current and high-water RSS
memory_profiles.description: Each child records Linux current RSS and process high-water RSS at entry, after head load, and shutdown. The high-water value already includes interpreter and import startup and is not aggregate colony memory.

numerical_profiles.label: Python CPU FP32 exact control
numerical_profiles.description: One-thread PyTorch FP32 execution compares raw and clipped gradients, AdamW tensors, complete model tensors, loss, routing, and replacement result bytes exactly.

worker_profiles.label: Trusted local spawned process
worker_profiles.description: The coordinator creates a local multiprocessing pipe and child. SHA-256 identities detect frame mismatch within that trusted scope; they do not authenticate an untrusted remote peer.
